Arroyo: 3 directions

A serif for a long policy essay that is read on screen and printed as a PDF. It should feel like a flare serif (stems that widen toward their ends, no brackets or slabs) and must not look like a default web serif. It needs a light and a bold, an italic, and it has to stay readable at 16px. It pairs with a neutral sans for captions.
